name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump says he won't rule out sending ground troops to Iran
changes.summary: President Trump told Fox News on Tuesday that he won't rule out a ground invasion of Iran. The comments come amid another round of U.S. strikes against Iranian targets. CBS News' Eleanor Watson reports.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump says the U.S. will collect tolls and impose blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, man killed by federal agents in Maine, states sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros merger.

changes.title: E. Jean Carroll Receives $5.6 Million Payment From Trump in Civil Case
changes.summary: A federal jury found President Trump liable for sexually abusing and defaming Ms. Carroll. He exhausted his appeals last month, prompting a judge to order that the money be paid.

changes.title: ‘I Am Frustrated’: Emails Show Blanche’s Role in Trump’s Retribution Campaign
changes.summary: The cooperation of Todd Blanche will be a flashpoint in his confirmation hearing to be attorney general on Wednesday.

changes.title: Trump administration orders ICE to suspend most vehicle stops after deadly shootings
changes.summary: The suspension is not absolute and there's room for exceptions when executing a criminal warrant or working with partner agencies.

changes.title: ICE Ordered to Cease Most Vehicle Stops After Fatal Shootings in Maine and Houston
changes.summary: Agents fatally shot a man in Houston and another in coastal Maine, both in their vehicles. The killings were the latest in a string of ICE shootings during President Trump’s second term.

changes.title: Trump Paid $2 Million by South Korean Company Facing Trade Investigation
changes.summary: The payment illustrates the minefield Mr. Trump has created by maintaining personal financial ties with foreign businesses while he is in office.

changes.title: Trump’s Canceled Plan to Charge a Toll in the Strait of Hormuz: What to Know
changes.summary: A day after President Trump announced a hefty 20 percent fee on cargo through the waterway, he reversed his decision.

changes.title: Maine Democrats criticize GOP Sen. Susan Collins after fatal ICE shooting of motorist in the state
changes.summary: A federal immigration agent fatally shot a motorist just south of Maine's largest city on Monday, the second time in a week that ICE has used deadly force on American soil and at least the ninth death since President Donald Trump began his immigration crackdown.

changes.title: Inflation eased in June, but Americans still feel pressure from high prices
changes.summary: A report shows inflation eased more than expected in June. It's welcome news for President Trump, who has made lowering prices a focus of his economic agenda. But months of higher-than-expected inflation have continued to squeeze many households and raised questions about when consumers will feel relief. Liz Landers re.
